note: Every company has one pet with its basic capabilities in pets/<company>/pet.json. This registry lists the extra, service-backed capabilities and which pets have them. An entry describes source in this repository; it does not prove a live provider, host or Chibi connection.

capabilities.title: Spoken voice
capabilities.description: Speaks and listens with a per-pet Gemini TTS voice and can relay a conversation to the next pet.

capabilities.title: Visual observation with Nemotron
capabilities.description: Observes an image with Nemotron VL, picks fixed tools, synthesizes evidence and checks the proposed answer.

capabilities.title: Drawing questions with visual evidence
capabilities.description: Stoa binds a construction-drawing question to declared page regions and NVIDIA observes those regions; Stoa keeps the geometry checks and final answer.

capabilities.title: Find and verify objects (Chibi Lens)
capabilities.description: Retrieves source-backed sightings of personally important objects and guides one grounded step at a time.

capabilities.title: Learned help in the current view
capabilities.description: Adds an admitted learning suggestion to the Lens resume episode, with the amount of explanation set by the user's preference.

capabilities.title: Aiven and MariaDB developer workflow
capabilities.description: Joins pinned public Aiven documentation, the synthetic MariaDB analyzer and durable PostgreSQL replay in one finite workflow.

capabilities.title: Typed answers with human-approved changes
capabilities.description: Answers in a typed schema; every requested or recommended change becomes a Chibi pending action that a person approves or declines. The model executes nothing.

capabilities.title: Rule checks and one repair turn
capabilities.description: Deterministic checks beyond the schema (missing proposal, personal data without classification or residency, echoed secrets, unflagged embedded instructions) feed one repair turn.

capabilities.title: Replayable event log (flight recorder)
capabilities.description: Outbox, Kafka and an idempotent consumer keep one effect per action under duplicates, a consumer crash and full replay; live mode uses Aiven for Kafka and PostgreSQL.

capabilities.title: Read-only Aiven project inspection
capabilities.description: Observes services, topics and plans through a read-only Aiven MCP connection with typed identifiers; answers are checked against the Aiven API.

capabilities.title: Challenger evaluation
capabilities.description: Other companions write fresh cases; rubrics are calibrated before answers; two judges grade with consensus and confidence intervals.
